_about: Mrs. Sherwood's moral tales for children: The Wishing Cap (undated in the text) and Soffrona and Her Cat Muff (1828). The Fairchild Family is Mary E. Palgrave's edition with her introduction (New York: Frederick A. Stokes, undated in the text; the Internet Archive catalogue record of the Stokes printing, fairchildfamily00sher, gives 1902). It was held for Palgrave's missing dates until Adam's ruling of 2026-10-10 (decision 22: US public domain is the rule). Shanty the Blacksmith (PG 12315) has no plain-text file at Gutenberg. Gutenberg catalogue: Sherwood 1775-1851. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-10: Adam asked the project to keep going until he stops it; Adam may veto).
